findings.message: A screen may have at most one primary action; found 2 ("Submit", "Save").
Action label "Submit" does not state the action; name the outcome (e.g. "Create account", "Delete project").
Destructive action "Delete everything" must open a confirmation dialog (action.kind "open-dialog" targeting a destructive Dialog).
Destructive action "Delete everything" must sit inside a danger-zone region, separated from routine controls.
Field "email" (email) should set an autocomplete token to help password managers and assistive tech.
Form "signup" must be single-column so it reflows on narrow viewports.
